title: Understanding the Performance Plateau in Text-to-Video Retrieval: A Comprehensive Empirical and Linguistic Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2605.00826v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-video retrieval enables users to find relevant video content using natural language queries, a task that has grown increasingly important with the rapid expansion of online video. Over the past six years, research has produced numerous methods, such as dual encoders, attention-driven models, and multimodal fusion approaches; however, fundamental questions remain about model behavior, dataset influence, and query difficulty. In this work, we evaluate 14 state-of-the-art retrieval methods across 3 widely used datasets under a unified preprocessing and evaluation framework. We analyze caption characteristics, including length, clarity, semantic category, and Action vs. Scene balance, and link these to model performance. translated_title: 理解文本到视频检索中的性能瓶颈：一项全面的实证与语言学分析
translated_abstract: 文本到视频检索使用户能够通过自然语言查询找到相关的视频内容，随着在线视频的快速增长，这项任务变得越来越重要。在过去六年中，研究产生了众多方法，例如双编码器、注意力驱动模型和多模态融合方法；然而，关于模型行为、数据集影响以及查询难度的基本问题仍然存在。在本工作中，我们在统一的预处理和评估框架下，对3个广泛使用的数据集上的14种最先进的检索方法进行了评估。我们分析了描述文本（字幕）的特征，包括长度、清晰度、语义类别以及动作与场景描述的平衡，并将这些特征与模型性能相关联。我们的结果表明，简短、清晰且简单的字幕（例如描述单一动作或颜色属性的字幕）能够获得更高的召回率，而复杂事件、多步骤活动或细粒度场景……
tldr: 该论文在统一的预处理与评估框架下对3个数据集上的14种最先进文本到视频检索方法进行了全面实证与语言学分析，发现简短清晰的字幕（如描述单一动作或颜色属性）能获得更高召回率，而复杂事件与多步骤活动是导致性能停滞的关键因素。
en_tdlr: This paper comprehensively evaluates 14 state-of-the-art text-to-video retrieval methods across 3 datasets under a unified framework, revealing that short and clear captions describing simple actions or attributes achieve higher recall, while complex events and multi-step activities are the key causes of the performance plateau.
